method: episodes re-simulated from the manifest's config on the data it recorded (the synthetic world, or the real panel's eval split, refused when the panel was rebuilt since), as the harness runs them (a PPO run with the policy.zip it saved, not retrained); equity and margin read at every step from the env (margin as optspread.margin books it: max loss for defined risk, the Cboe rule otherwise); return on cash is P&L over initial cash, return on margin is P&L over the peak margin the episode held, drawdown is peak to trough within each episode
